_note: REQ-L10N-013: English of the web prototype's own screen texts (site/app.js), keyed by the Japanese it renders. Server texts come from server/master/locale-en.json + server/src/i18n/en.ts, game-layer texts from engine/Muchi.Client/Resources/Muchi/ui-en.json; all three are compiled into one catalog in logic/entry.ts (MuchiLogic.l10n). The EN toggle translates every text node on the stage through it (app.js). test/en-flow.cjs fails on any Japanese left on the key screens and on text that overflows its box.

strings.交換所のあるイベントはありません: No event has an exchange right now

strings.持っていないパーツ: Parts you do not own yet

strings.一度買えばずっと使えます（期限なし）。: Once bought, it is yours to keep (no expiry).
strings.実況の話し方を選べます。試聴は何度でも、買う前でも聞けます: Choose how the race is called. Listen as often as you like, even before buying
strings.青葉競馬場 芝1600m · ストックのレース · 10秒: Aoba Racecourse Turf 1600m · stock race · 10 seconds
strings.「試聴する」で、そのパックの実況が流れます（声の素材が無い時は字幕だけ）: Press Listen to hear the pack call a race (subtitles only when the voice files are not downloaded)
strings.確率のない直販です。買う前に何度でも試聴できます。: A direct sale with no random draw. You can listen as often as you like before buying.
strings.マイリプレイは今は表示できません: My Replays can't be shown right now
strings.自分のレースを残して、いつでも見返せます · 保存は無料で{n}件まで: Keep your own races and watch them again any time  ·  save up to {n} for free
strings.名場面と最近のレース / 自動で入れ替わります: Best moments and recent races  /  they rotate automatically
strings.レースを走ると、勝利・写真判定・自己ベストがここに並びます: Run races and your wins, photo finishes and personal bests line up here
strings.アカウント削除の手続き中のため、保存できません: Your account is being deleted, so replays can't be saved
strings.保存はリプレイの記録（設定と操作）だけです。見る時に端末で同じレースを再計算しま: Only the race record (setup and inputs) is saved. Your device re-runs the same race when you watch it
strings.アカウント削除の手続き中のため、公開できません: Your account is being deleted, so replays can't be made public

strings.名前・IDは入りません（選んだ馬の名前だけ）: No names or IDs are included (only the chosen horse's name)
strings.共有しました（アプリでは共有シートを開きます）: Shared (the app opens the share sheet)

strings.カメラはコースより下に入りません: The camera never goes below the track
strings.鍵の付いた品は実績で解放、または見た目ショップで決まった価格で買えます（ランダム: Locked items unlock with achievements, or can be bought at a fixed price in the cosmetics shop (never random)
strings.ひとことは翻訳されません。URL・賭けを思わせる言葉・ショップの宣伝の言葉は使え: Captions are never translated. URLs, betting words and shop advertising words cannot be used.
strings.写真に重ねる見た目だけです。レースの能力には影響しません。: Looks on the photo only. No effect on race stats.
strings.共有の文と画像に、ほかのプレイヤーの名前・IDは入れません。: The share text and image never include other players' names or IDs.
strings.共有しました（画像の書き出しと共有シートはアプリで行います）: Shared (the app renders the image and opens the share sheet)
strings.留守の間のできごと: What happened while you were away
strings.タップでその画面へ: Tap a row to open it
strings.いいね・応援スタンプ・プレゼントは、まとめて1件で表示します。: Likes, cheer stamps and gifts are grouped into one row.
strings.プレゼントの受け取りはプレゼントボックスで行います。: Gifts are claimed in the gift box.
strings.プッシュ通知の設定はプッシュだけに効きます。この一覧はいつでも見られます。: Push settings only change pushes. This list is always available.
